composition: dense field with disc crown above, target frieze below
description: Dense with surface incident, this mixed-media collage layers drawn warplane silhouettes, gold record discs, iridescent CDs, and concentric target motifs across a ground of printed ephemera including USPS Express Mail packaging and handwritten text. Red horizontal bands, a heart-patterned pink rectangle, and multicolored bullseye circles punctuate the composition throughout.
title: Squadron and Disc Crown
